draft_hub_record_all_or_none.name: draft_hub_record_all_or_none
draft_hub_record_all_or_none.value:
("draft"."hub_record_kind" is null and "draft"."hub_record_id" is null and "draft"."hub_record_label_enc" is null)
        or ("draft"."hub_record_kind" is not null and "draft"."hub_record_id" is not null and "draft"."hub_record_label_enc" is not null)

hub_link_kind_fks.name: hub_link_kind_fks
hub_link_kind_fks.value:
("hub_link"."kind" = 'person_company' and "hub_link"."person_id" is not null and "hub_link"."company_id" is not null and "hub_link"."project_id" is null)
        or ("hub_link"."kind" = 'person_project' and "hub_link"."person_id" is not null and "hub_link"."project_id" is not null and "hub_link"."company_id" is null)
        or ("hub_link"."kind" = 'company_project' and "hub_link"."company_id" is not null and "hub_link"."project_id" is not null and "hub_link"."person_id" is null)

hub_project_dates_order.name: hub_project_dates_order
hub_project_dates_order.value: "hub_project"."end_date" is null or "hub_project"."start_date" is null or "hub_project"."end_date" >= "hub_project"."start_date"
